recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composite featuring a diverse group of women in confident poses against a heavily textured purple wall, framed by high-contrast yellow graphic elements and bold, condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchors the composition with a direct gaze and crossed arms.
Large-scale numeric graphic overlaps the central subjects to create depth.
Horizontal yellow bands at the top and bottom provide structural framing.
The purple background texture contrasts with the smooth skin tones of the subjects.
coreInvariants: Acid yellow as the primary graphic color.
Symmetrical character arrangement around a central axis.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A line of seven women standing in the mid-ground, with one woman kneeling in the lower right foreground. Subjects are scaled to fill the vertical space between the yellow banners.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow '2' in the lower center and the central woman with crossed arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move outward to the flanking characters, then drop to the large central graphic and bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures to convey a sense of a large group or team.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple with a stippled texture serves as the environmental backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Acid yellow provides high-visibility for all graphic and typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Varied clothing colors (green, red, black, patterned) distinguish individual characters.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow graphics against a darker, mid-tone purple creates a vibrant, energetic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between text and background

characterSpecificRedesigns: The large central numeral features a spray-paint or stencil-like texture around the edges.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospaced or wide-tracked condensed sans-serif for secondary metadata to create a rhythmic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the main title.
Provides a cleaner, more modern alternative for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of diverse women in modern casual-chic attire, standing in a line with confident expressions. The background should be a dark purple wall with a heavy concrete or sponge-painted texture. Leave a solid yellow bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply extra-condensed bold yellow sans-serif text in the center. Add a large yellow numeral with spray-paint edge effects in the lower center. Place a wide-tracked yellow text line across the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow high-visibility against the purple?
Are the characters' expressions confident and direct?
Is the central numeral large enough to overlap the subjects?
Is the typography strictly uppercase and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Degree of spray-paint splatter on the central graphic
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible and not distorted by AI generation.
Check that the yellow bars are perfectly horizontal.
Verify the purple background has a consistent 'grunge' texture.
Confirm the central figure remains the focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast + Textured complementary background + High-contrast condensed typography + Framing horizontal bands.
